what: The strike ledger (2026-11-06, Sailor: tanker and refinery strikes count in the supply shock tracker as events, and seed the casualty tracker). One row per reported or claimed strike on a refinery or a tanker. asOf = the day it happened; detected = the day it was reported. status: reported (a named source says it happened) · claimed (an attacker says so, unconfirmed) · confirmed (the operator or a government says so). firms = what the satellites saw at the site (a flag date, 'not seen', or null where the site isn't watched). Hand-dated; the pipeline never writes here. No row says who meant what (PG01 §6.3.2).
